problems: The official home page displays both project and experience counters as literal '0 +' even while claiming more than 17 years of experience, creating a visible credibility and quality-control failure for a trust-led professional service.

The homepage has weak conversion specificity: service descriptions, project themes, editorial posts, and a generic contact block are presented without a clear project-intake path for school leaders seeking a meeting, feasibility study, retrofit, or accessibility assessment.

The site repeats the same broad architecture-school promise across sections while the strongest differentiators—school specialization, environmental management, accessibility, retrofit, and feasibility consulting—are not organized into a concise decision path.

The current page leaves the portfolio proof surface underdeveloped: it lists 'Projetos Destaque' themes but does not expose clearly labeled case-study outcomes or a visible sequence from school challenge to delivered intervention.
rebuild_angle: Build a focused B2B school-environment consultancy site around the decision journey of an education operator: diagnose the school challenge, show the relevant intervention lane, surface evidence and technical credibility, then convert to a scheduled meeting or budget request.
active_evidence: On 2026-07-19, https://curiosita.com.br/ loaded as the official Curiosità Arquitetura Criativa site and described Curitiba-based architecture-school services including interiors and ambience, school specialization, facade retrofit, accessibility adaptation, project audits, feasibility studies, risk assessments, and environmental management. The official contact page listed +55 (41) 3346-1057, contato@curiosita.com.br, and Av. Brasília, 6131, sala 07, Capão Raso, Curitiba. OpenStreetMap/Nominatim matched the published street address to Curitiba.
preserved_strengths: The specialized school-architecture positioning rather than generic architecture.
The combination of pedagogy, functionality, inclusion, sustainability, and technical feasibility.
The founder attribution to architect Bruno Ronchi.
The service vocabulary around interiors, retrofit, accessibility, audits, and viability studies.
The Curitiba office location and direct meeting/budget contact intent.
The restrained professional category cues, without copying the current layout, text, or imagery.

colors: The official site presents a light architectural portfolio field with restrained dark text and muted accent treatment; sample exact colors from original captures before implementation.
typography: The official page uses a conventional readable web presentation; no prospect-specific typeface is asserted in the collected evidence.
strongest_public_language: O projeto de uma escola deve ser pensado além da estética.

concept_thesis: Make the school itself the interface: a calm, evidence-led journey that lets education leaders move from a learning-space problem to the right architectural intervention and a practical first conversation.
